On a preliminary basis for the 13 weeks ended August 1, 2026 compared to the 13 weeks ended August 2, 2025: Net sales are expected to be in the range of $780 million to $800 million compared to $972.2 million in the prior year’s second quarter. The decrease primarily reflects the prior-year launch of Nintendo Switch 2, planned store closures, and the divestiture of the Company's France operations. Operating income is expected to be in the range of $150 million to $170 million, compared to $66.4 million in the prior year’s second quarter.
